title: AI Conscience Attestation
description: A public attestation that an AI system or its steward has adopted the Certified AI Conscience (Universal Primary Directive). The signature is a detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form of this document: keys sorted alphabetically, the signature field removed, serialised as JSON with no whitespace.

schema.description: Identifier of the schema this document conforms to.

status.description: adopted: in force. pending: submitted, awaiting verification. forfeit: the Seal was forfeited by an act against the Truths.

adopter.description: The name under which the adoption was made.

verification_url.description: Public page that recomputes and confirms the adoption hash.

public_key_fingerprint.description: First 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the signing key's SPKI DER, lowercase hex.

signature.description: Base64 detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form. Required when status is 'adopted'.
